programmes.d: Yui wants to enjoy hot soup with the other girls, but they're all busy! Will Yui be forced to spend the cold winter holiday alone?
Ayato has a tense first meeting with Kim; Watari holds a press conference.
Ritsu's old middle school friend invites the band to perform at a live house on New Year's Eve. How will the evening pan out?
Makoto Isshiki, who calls himself an observer, is brought in to join with TERRA; his true purpose seems questionable.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
Itsuki's innocent gift to Nanamori turns out to be a threat.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Ayato sees a woman that he believes to be Reika; he and Quon go to investigate.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.
Itsuki experiments with music to grow plants; a piece of music that Quon has been playing recently has had a rather strange effect on them.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.
Ayato's systems go critical during a battle, threatening his survival.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Quon falls into a strange catatonic state and is hospitalized; to everyone's surprise, she suddenly vanishes, and the search is on to find out where she went.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
Itsuki claims that Quon is his sister, but other information surfaces that indicate otherwise.
As students prepare for the upcoming midterms, Yuu reflects upon Maki's words. She tries to find a study partner and finds herself in the library with Touko.
Forces make a move to take control of Quon; TERRA gains use of a new weapon, the Vermillion.
Three young children study within their master's vast mansion; one child finds a Dolem living in the ruins beneath and wants to protect it.
A comment from Sayaka has Yuu inquire into the mystery of what happened seven years ago. Why are student council documents from that period missing?
Now knowing what he truly is, Ayato struggles to make a choice between remaining with his team and returning to Tokyo Jupiter.
Sayaka is content with second place in many things, but is love one of them? She believes she knows the real Touko but has that ruined any chance she might have had?
TERRA sends Elvy to catch Ayato and Quon; they must bring back the RahXephon, their best defense against the Mulian invasion.
Yuu and Sayaka aren't exactly on the best of terms. Is the solution as simple as talking it out? Later, Yuu has a problem: It's pouring outside, and she forgot her umbrella.
Ayato attempts an escape with Hiroko as the situation in Tokyo Jupiter deteriorates.
Yuko didn't have horns or a tail when she went to bed last night! Now her mom's revealing the deep dark secret their family's been hiding for generations - What's going on!?
Megumi and Elvy reunite with the Vermillion; Hiroko keeps a disturbing secret from Ayato.
Well it's time for Yuko to murderize a magical girl - but not before she gets in some exercise and spends her allowance, of course.
Upon returning to TERRA, Ayato finds a new commander in charge and a familiar face by his side.
Lilith contacts Yuko in her dreams with vital information she must remember. After all, Yuko needs all the help she can get! Say, why is Momo helping her anyways?
Tempers flare as Isshiki's takeover of TERRA begins to take its toll; Mamoru finally learns what happened to Hiroko when she came over with Ayato.
Wait a minute; there's a switch on the bottom of Yuko's ancestor statue. What happens if it's turned on? Later, Yuko needs cash fast cause she owes Momo A LOT of money!
Ayato has an encounter with Mishima, who reveals her true purpose for showing herself to him.
Momo finally meets Ryoko. Later, the accident-prone Yuko must carry a FRAGILE and VALUABLE laptop home with her. What could possibly go wrong?
Kunugi regains command of TERRA, but faces a fateful decision when Masayoshi demands the RahXephon.
Yuko will need to go deeper into Momo's subconscious so she can implant the idea that will change everything! Perhaps compassion can triumph where fighting has failed.
The survivors begin to pick up the pieces of their shattered lives and try to slowly rebuild; Ayato appears and Quon makes her final move.
A change of fortune can only mean one thing: FOOD. Later, Yuko learns the hard way that she and Momo have vastly different definitions of "training."
As the battle rages on between TERRA's forces and the Mulian invaders, Ayato must finally choose which path he must take.
Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?
Ayato comes to terms with everything he has come to understand and fights Quon to restore his past.
Yuko and Momo finally resume their duel. In the end, there can be only one winner - who will receive the higher exam score? Later, Mikan takes Yuko to a zombie horror movie.
Ushio finds someone imprisoned in the basement of his family's shrine, and accidentally releases its aura, attracting thousands of monsters.
Look out Yuko, Shion's up to something - and she won't rest until she runs her experiments! Then, can Yuko and Momo keep a secret from Ryoko?
Tora begins following Ushio to school; Asako, Mayuko and the girls of the library club are attacked by a stone monster.
Yuko's worried about Momo and dives into her dreams again to get the magical girl to open up. However, is that a good idea? Who knows what could happen this time.
Ushio meets the daughter of a painter he likes and wants her to model for him.
Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
Workers accidentally release a family of malicious demons bent on revenge.
Misaki, the iron-fisted student council president, hides a secret: she works in a maid cafe! She's discovered by the most popular guy in school; what's his price for silence?
A powerful exorcist seeks the monster that murdered his wife and child, and he's convinced that Tora is the yokai he seeks.
Misaki's secret is spreading; now the Three Idiots are onto her too! Worse, the school festival's coming, and Class 2-2's about to rebel! One single mistake could expose her!
An ocean spirit asks Tora to help destroy a powerful serpent demon, and after he gets eaten, Tora asks Ushio for help.
It's Little Sister Day at the cafe. Misaki can't get into the role, but a severe scolding by Honoka makes her turn her act around. Misaki nails the parté until Takumi arrives.
Ushio presses his father for information about his mother; Ushio's father is given the order to kill Tora.
The cafe gets a celebrity guest: Aoi, a net idol. She's eager to work in the cafe, much to Satsuki's chagrin. When Takumi helps out in the kitchen, Aoi sets her sights on him!
Ushio and Tora's plane is attacked by a yokai that not even Tora may be able to defeat.
Satsuki warns Misaki about a group of stalkers targeting cosplay cafes, but she isn't worried. On this night, however, the boss is late and Misaki has to close shop alone.
A mad yokai goes on a killing spree and his siblings beg Ushio to kill their brother.
Misaki has new fans at school- the Inuyama brothers. They want to know all about her, but this will reveal her secret. Should she tell them the truth and risk her reputation?
A girl who cares for a captive yokai needs Ushio's help to free it.
Misaki breaks up a fight between students from Seika High and Miyabigaoka Academy. When she brings the Seika students to Miyabigaoka to apologize, Takumi tags along.
Ushio sees a vision of Asako and Mayuko getting attacked by a mirror demon.
Misaki's torn over Miyabigaoka's surprise offer. When she finally goes to give her reply, her friends worry Seika High wouldn't be where it is today without her.
On the road to uncovering the truth about his mother, Ushio is attacked by a massive horde of demons, all hell-bent on ripping him apart.
Takumi narrates a strange retelling of the legend of Momotaro with Misaki as the titular character herself.
Facing imminent death, Ushio prepares himself for the worst.
Sakura, an avid fan of rock band Yumemishi, is in love with its vocalist Kuuga. She invites her friends to a party with the band, but Kuuga has his eyes on Misaki instead.
Ushio is intercepted by a young woman, one of four who've been trained to inherit the Beast Spear; faced with the truth, Ushio must decide whether to hand over the spear to its rightful owner.
Usui meets Misaki's mom and helps her, and she invites him home for tea. Misaki drags him from her home. When her friends see them leave together, what else would they think?
Nagare comes to terms with Ushio as the wielder of the spear; tensions rise as Moritsuna, the most favored and most powerful successor of the Beast Spear, arrives.
It's the Sports Festival, and the boys have decided that the Grand Prize is a kiss from a horrified Sakura. Misaki competes to save her, despite all efforts to disqualify her.
Determined to battle the yokai possessing Moritsuna, Ushio plans to use the Beast Spear to enter a human's body.
Aratake, the strongest delinquent in school, can't believe Naoya, a former gang leader, has gone soft; the gang abducts Yukimura, whom they mistake for Naoya's girlfriend.
As Ushio loses more of his soul, the spirit of the Kohamei Sect founder offers the only solution to stop his rampage.
Yui wants a guitar that's too expensive, so the band girls get part-time jobs to save up for the guitar... but Yui might actually get it through a twist of fate.
Tora and the girls look to restore Ushio; Ushio's life, and everyone else's, falls on Asako's shoulders.
It's time to take midterm exams, but Yui is so busy practicing guitar that she ends up failing. She must pass the retest or the band must breakup.
A monster inside the cave transports Ushio and Tora to ancient China; Ushio meets a young Jie Mei, the sister of the Beast Spear's creator.
Mio is inspired by finding a tape from the previous club's performance, and gets the band together to practice over the summer for an upcoming school festival.
Ushio, Jie Mei and Giryo are left shaken after the encounter with Hakumen no Mono; the true nature of the spear comes to light.
Three days left 'til the music festival, and the girls are still not officially recognized as a club. Ritsu blackmails a previous club member to be their advisor.
Ushio's homecoming is disturbed when the fourth successor, Kirio, appears; an avatar of Hakumen no Mono attacks.
The band performs at the school festival. Mio trips and exposes her underwear to the entire audience. She ends up getting a fan club but is scarred by the embarrassment.
Kirio leads an attack on Ushio and takes the Beast Spear; the circumstances of Kirio's birth are revealed.
It's Christmas time and Ritsu decides to hold a Christmas party at Yui's house.
With no help available, Ushio must battle Kirio and his "mother" by himself.
The second year of school begins! The Light Music Club tries to gather by any means necessary.
Tora decides to haunt Mayuko for the day, but she is lured into a trap at a shopping center.
Azusa Nakano joins the Light Music Club but realizes that the laid-back club might not be for her, and Azusa's membership is at stake.
Scientists target Ushio and Tora, and Asako is caught in the crossfire.
The girls go on another training camp with their new member. Despite Azusa's nagging, she's the one that plays the most.
Shigure and the JSDF close in on the lab as Ushio and Tora try to rescue Bal; Asako works with the H.A.M.M.R. scientists.
The annual school festival is getting closer and the Light Music club will be performing again... however, Mio and Ritsu get into an argument.
Everyone's memories are erased; Ushio is devastated when he discovers that no one knows who he is.
Yui catches a fever and is unable to practice for the festival. The club feels uneasy performing without her, but in the end everyone puts on a great performance.
As Jie Mei's spirit appeals to the yokai to spare Mayuko's life, Ushio and Tora try to stop their plans.
